scientific_findings: The stabilized execution_ready abstraction generalizes behaviorally to a real plan-bound execution family that predates and did not design the activation abstraction.
A model-load-time immutable execution plan can act as an upstream readiness authority without becoming a separately acquired per-request primitive representation.
Shared control-plane metadata residency is distinct from primitive representation residency.
Plan invalidity or preferred executor unavailability can lower preferred execution_ready and expose an existing safe fallback without an ACQUIRE or EVICT action.
The generic no-ready-route rule remains sufficient when neither preferred nor fallback is ready.
No evidence from this holdout requires an activation enum/state machine or a family-specific policy branch.

independence_boundary.reason: ANL64 Q4_FAST inherited subgroup32 split-K component evidence from SA1. The holdout therefore validates an independent plan-bound activation/control structure, not independent arithmetic ancestry.
